verdict_summary: No critical/high. XSS check clean: all instance-derived interpolations in render-html.ts route through esc() or hljs (self-escaping). graph.ts hard-bounded at depth 2.

findings.description: resolveTable ACL fetch uses unanchored nameSTARTSWITH<table>: 'incident' also matches ACLs of 'incident_sla' etc. Spec Security/ACL section silently includes unrelated tables' ACLs.
findings.suggested_fix: name=<table>^ORnameSTARTSWITH<table>. (exact OR table.field) instead of bare STARTSWITH.

findings.description: Dictionary mapping: reference uses cellValue only while type uses cellDisplay||cellValue; displayValue:'all' means reference arrives as {value,display_value} -> Data Model 'References' column shows raw sys_id instead of table name.
io_set_item labelField 'variable_set' is a Reference field; fetchPage queries displayValue:false so raw sys_id (truthy) wins over pickLabel fallback -> 'Variable sets' list renders sys_ids.
findings.suggested_fix: Query with displayValue for that spec, or resolve reference-typed labelFields via cellDisplay before pickLabel.

findings.description: super_class (reference) rendered raw in 'Extends' column -> sys_id instead of parent table name. Same class as variable_set bug.
resolveBusinessRule pushes a sys_db_object?name=<collection> lookup per BR; table-root spec with N BRs on same table -> N identical sequential REST calls (dedupe happens only after fetch).
findings.suggested_fix: Memoize FetchSpec results by (table,query) per walk, or skip re-deriving target table when collection == primary table.

findings.description: walkGraph awaits each FetchSpec sequentially; busy tables serialize hundreds of round-trips -> generation feels hung.
findings.suggested_fix: Promise.all per depth with bounded concurrency (5-10).

findings.description: codeParagraphs emits one styled Paragraph per code line; hundreds-of-line scripts x many artifacts -> thousands of OOXML paragraphs, large/sluggish .docx.
findings.suggested_fix: Single Paragraph with TextRuns+break:1 per block, or named paragraph style.

findings.description: opts.logoDataUri interpolated unescaped into img src. Currently fed only by bundled asset (main.ts:2031) — not exploitable today; latent attribute-breakout if a future caller passes untrusted string.
findings.suggested_fix: Require data:image/ prefix or attribute-escape as defense-in-depth.

findings.description: esc() does not escape single quote; safe today (double-quoted attrs/text only), unsafe if future single-quoted attribute usage.
findings.suggested_fix: Escape ' as ' or document as double-quote-only.

findings.description: 'Example — list records' curl block tagged lang:'javascript' -> nonsense JS highlighting + wasted Prettier attempt (caught).
Level-3 subheadings (individual BR/CS/SI/ACL names) get no anchor ids; no deep-linking to a specific artifact from TOC.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend slug/id assignment to level-3; optional TOC tier.

findings.description: No tests for spec-runner (graceful-degradation contract + dictionary mapping where the reference bug lives) or format.ts.
findings.suggested_fix: spec-runner.test.ts (failed fetch degrades, reference display preserved); format.test.ts (happy path + unformatted fallback).

findings.description: fetchPage returns [] both for zero matches and for failed requests; spec shows 'No X discovered' even when a section is silently incomplete.
findings.suggested_fix: Report fetch failures via warnings/diagnostics so UI can show 'could not verify' distinctly.

purpose_notes_file: see task transcript; key notes inlined in consolidated findings

unclear_code.why_unclear: catalog_client_script mapped to resolveScriptInclude but GlideAjax calls use processor-name strings the extractor can't detect — possibly an effective no-op kept for future detection.
displayValue:false possibly deliberate (raw values for booleans/dates) vs oversight for reference labelFields; fix shape (per-field vs global 'all') needs a decision.
